correctness.rationale: The potential-coordinate polar constraints |x_i-y_j|<=1 and connected tight-edge incidence at vertices give lattice integrality. For dilation n, fixing the p-side potentials with x1=0 and range r leaves exactly (2n+1-r)^q independent second-side choices; the number of first-side vectors of range r is (r+1)^p-2r^p+(r-1)^p for r>=1. This proves the universal lattice count including p=1 and n=0. Ehrhart degree d=p+q-1 plus d+1 exact Newton samples completely determines each coefficient. A fresh independently coded Fraction finite-difference interpolator enumerated all 49 unordered classes d<=13, checked the leading volume 2^d p!q!, and found only (7,7), dimension13, c1=-7184/715 nonpositive. Independent small direct lattice counts matched. This is an exhaustive finite cutoff statement, not extrapolation beyond dimension13.
